items.docs: Exchange an M2M client ID and secret for a bearer access token. This endpoint does not require authentication.

params.name: cursor
params.description:
Opaque pagination token from the previous response’s `nextCursor`. Omit on the first page.

Page size is controlled by the `limit` query parameter (default 200, maximum 1000).

params.name: limit
params.description:
Maximum number of records to return in this page.
Omit to use the default (200); the maximum allowed value is 1000.
Values above the maximum return HTTP 400 with code `err:pulsar.request.invalid-limit`.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter results by field values using the syntax `filter[<field>][<op>]=<value>`.

Operators by field type:
- **string**: `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `notIn`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`
- **number**: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `notIn`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`
- **boolean**: `eq`, `ne`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`
- **date**: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `isNull`, `isNotNull`

For `in` and `notIn`, provide comma-separated values: `filter[tag_id][in]=a,b,c`.
For `isNull` and `isNotNull`, the value is ignored.

Multiple filters are combined with AND.

Examples:
- `filter[event_date][gte]=2024-01-01`
- `filter[company_id][eq]=abc123`
- `filter[has_click][eq]=true`
- `filter[ad_campaign_id][isNull]=true`
- `filter[tag_id][in]=foo,bar`

params.name: ipAddress
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up

items.docs:
Returns company information associated with the supplied IP address.

Company fields may be null when the IP address is known but a company relationship could
not be determined. A `404` is returned only when no record exists for the IP address. When a `404`
is returned, our backend systems will automatically begin resolving the IP so that it becomes
available soon.

Requires the `ip:read` scope on the Bearer token. A `403` is returned if the scope is absent.
